description.value: Big Star Sandwich Co. is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013 by tradesman-turned-restaurateur Clint Bondzuk, now operating six locations across the region. Their signature filone bread — a rustic cross between ciabatta and baguette — is loaded with in-house slow-roasted beef (13 hours overnight), hand-pulled turkey, and imported bacon, all sliced fresh daily. The Richmond location on Coppersmith Way also offers catering and online ordering, making it a practical stop for a hearty mid-ride meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Richmond location is confirmed active on the website, with address '100-11331 Coppersmith Way' and phone '(604) 275-8793' matching OSM values. The website confirms takeout and online ordering via a 'Delivery & Pickup' / 'Order Online' navigation link. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; OSM diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes tags cannot be confirmed from the website content, which focuses on meat-centric preparations.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Fr 10:00-19:00; Sa 10:00-18:00) differ from the website for the Richmond location (Mon-Fri 10:00AM-6:00PM; Sat 11:00AM-6:00PM). Website values appear more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible sandwich restaurant with a confirmed Richmond location — a practical food stop for touring cyclists.
